announcements.title: China trip fix, furnish your house
announcements.body: Traveling to China (and every other country) shows you and the HUD again. Inside a house you bought, open Build to place, move, and remove furniture. The squirrel's eyes are a bit softer too.

announcements.title: Walk into your cottage
announcements.summary: Bought houses open into a furnished room, the squirrel looks softer, and the pause menu credits the capybara call recordings.
announcements.imageAlt: Inside a cottage with a bed, sofa, lamp and table
body: After you build a cottage or another house on a plot, walk up to the door and step inside. Each one starts with a bed, sofa, table, rug and lamp. Snow stays outside, and the camera stays under the ceiling.
The pet squirrel has a rounder face, clearer eyes and a bushier tail so it sits better next to Mochi.

Pause shows a Credits section for the free capybara field recordings (Sidnei Dantas, CC BY-SA 4.0; Stan Rullman, CC BY 4.0) plus NASA Blue Marble and Natural Earth. The same notes are in the site footer.

announcements.title: Hills, a farm, and animal friends
announcements.summary: The park has rolling hills, a farm you can till and harvest, pushable trees for wood, apple trees, chickens, a pet squirrel, and real capybara calls.
announcements.imageAlt: Mochi at the farm plots with chickens nearby in the rolling fields
body: Walk out past the village and the ground rises into gentle hills while the square, roads, river and rails stay flat underfoot.

East of the square there is a farm. Buy pumpkin, carrot or wheat seeds from Maple or the seed stall, till a bed, plant, water, and harvest for CappyCoin. Growth follows the day and the season, and it pauses in winter or under heavy snow.
Trees on the hillsides can be pushed down for wood, and some grow apples you can pick. A flock of chickens wanders the farm and leave eggs. A squirrel can befriend you and follow along.
Hop, flop and quiet moments now play short field recordings of real capybaras, and the pause menu sound toggle still covers everything.

announcements.title: Open country worlds and a Run toggle
announcements.summary: Version 0.3.5 lets you walk open terrain in each country, with local plants, animals, and a hamlet, and adds a Run toggle for a faster walk.
body: Spin the globe in World and pick a country. You land in open terrain you can walk, with hills shaped from real elevation, plants and animals that fit the place, and a small hamlet of buildings. Afghanistan and Albania already have mapped buildings and roads; Algeria has buildings for now. The other countries are open country with a village, not a full capital street map.
Shift or the Run button toggles a faster walk, about 2.2 times your usual pace, and it stacks on top of a potion. On the broom, Shift still means descend.
Day lighting follows the sun more closely outdoors, so mornings and evenings feel different from noon when you roam.

announcements.title: Six new buildings you can walk into
announcements.summary: A school, a hospital, a general store, a boutique, a fire station and a police station now stand along Civic row. Each one has villagers inside and something to do.
announcements.imageAlt: Mochi outside the school, shopping for potions at the general store, sliding down the fire station pole, and outside the fire station with its red truck
body: Civic row, a short walk from the village square, has six new buildings. Walk up to a door to go in. Every building has a painted sign over the door and its own villagers inside, and the snow stays outside.

At the school, take a seat at a free desk for Ms. Clover's lesson of the day: three questions, coins for each right answer, and a gold star the first time you get them all. Dr. Hazel at the hospital gives quick check-ups that leave you running faster for a while. Maple's general store sells potions, and Lulu's boutique sells hats, scarves and more, which you put on straight away.

At the fire station you can slide down the pole and ring the alarm bell, and Sergeant Barley keeps a lost-and-found box at the police station. Chief Ember and Sergeant Barley each have a new quest too: a kitten is stuck on the school roof, and someone has lost a locket near the bridge.
The buttons and labels along the edges of the screen are also easier to read now, whether you are over fresh snow, bright sky or night.

announcements.title: Snow settles on the park
announcements.summary: When it snows in winter, the ground and the rooftops slowly turn white, and the snow melts away again after it stops.
announcements.imageAlt: Mochi's home park under fresh snow, with white roofs on the cottage, cafe, bakery and market stall
body: Snow no longer just falls past you. While it snows, a white layer builds up over a couple of minutes on the grass, on the roofs of every house and shop, on the station shelters and on the tops of trees and fences. Walls stay their usual colours, and the paths turn to grey slush where everyone walks.

When the snow stops, it melts away bit by bit. It lasts a long time on a cold winter day, goes faster in the sun and in the rain, and disappears quickly once spring comes. The river stays open the whole time.
Snow only falls in winter, so keep an eye on the sky display. In the shared park, everyone sees the same snow at the same moment.

announcements.title: Fly the broom
announcements.summary: Broom flight is rebuilt as smooth arcade flying, and your capybara now sits astride the broom like a proper rider.
announcements.imageAlt: Mochi the capybara sitting astride the broom, flying low over the path by home
body: The broom waits right next to you when you start. Press E to hop on. W and S set your speed, A and D turn, Space climbs, and Shift or C takes you down. Press E again to hop off.

The broom never drops out of the sky. It leans into turns and tips its nose up when you climb. Let go of W and it glides gently to a stop in the air, so you can look around before you choose where to land.

announcements.title: Day, night, and the weather
announcements.summary: A new sky display at the top of the screen shows the sun or moon, the time of day, the weather, and the season.
announcements.imageAlt: Night in Mochi's home park, with the sky display at the top showing the moon, 9:36 PM, clear, and autumn
body: Look to the top center of the screen. The sun or the moon tells you if it is day or night, with the time beside it and a little track that fills as the day goes by. Next to that are the weather and the season.
A whole day and night goes by in about twenty minutes. Every so often the weather turns: clear, cloudy, rain, storm, snow, or fog. Storms flash with lightning. Snow only falls in winter.
The season follows the calendar, so the village is in autumn right now. In the shared park, everyone sees the same sky at the same moment.

announcements.title: All aboard the new rail line
announcements.summary: The train tracks are rebuilt as one clean, connected line between all six stations.
announcements.imageAlt: The little red train crossing the wooden bridge over the river
body: The rails now run unbroken from station to station: Home, Village, Meadow, Hot springs, Forest, and the Mine. The line crosses the river on the bridge, and buffer stops mark the end of the line.
Walk up to a station and press E to pick where to go. Every station you have found is a stop. On the way, press E to hop off at the next station.

announcements.title: New rooms in the workshop
announcements.summary: CappyEngine Studio, the editor the village is built in, has new Outfit Studio and Building Studio windows.
body: Outfit Studio lists the clothes, shows them on a capybara, and lets each piece be nudged until it fits. Building Studio draws a building's walls, doors, and rooms from above and shows the furnished inside.
The whole editor has a cleaner look, too. These are the tools the village is made with, not something you need to play.

announcements.title: On the way
announcements.summary: Sound and music that follow the weather, a softer glowing look, snowy winters, and new buildings to walk into.
body: Sound and music are coming, with ambience that follows the weather and the time of day.
So is a graphics pass: a warm glow, softer shadows, and colors that shift with the time of day. The Map window is getting a globe, and in winter the ground and the roofs will turn snowy.
The town is growing too. A school, a hospital, shops, and fire and police stations are on the way, and you will be able to walk inside them.

announcements.title: Story, friends, and the world
announcements.summary: Version 0.3.4 opens Story mode, a shared park, and a world of countries. Ride the train, cast a line, and try a potion.
body: The menu now has three doors. Story mode is the village. Multiplayer is the same park with friends. World opens on a globe of the Earth painted from NASA Blue Marble imagery. Spin it, zoom in, and pick a country, with its own plants, animals, and a short quest.
In Story, the train runs between places you have found. Stand on the river bank and cast a line. Potions wait in the haunted house. A broom sits by the yard when you want to fly.

Friends in the park wear the clothes they have on. If the lobby cannot be reached, the game still works on your own. Clothes, coins, and quests stay in this browser. Pause, then Save code, if you want a copy you can paste back later.

announcements.title: Halloween Live Event
announcements.summary: The village sky turns Halloween dusk. The haunted house and the pumpkin meadow are waiting.
body: From October 1 through November 7, CappyWorld wears its Halloween light: a purple-orange dusk, stars a little earlier, and the same soft park you already know. It is the season already built into the game, not a separate mode.

Walk north from Mochi's home into the village, then west across the bridge to the haunted house in Whispering forest. The ghost inside only floats. East of home, the pumpkin meadow is full of pumpkins and hay bales you can knock over.
Bring a grown-up if you like. Nothing jumps out, and nothing ends the day. Hop, flop, say hello, and wander back before the moon is high.

announcements.title: Friends in the same park
announcements.summary: Open Play on two browsers or devices and join the park — you can see each other hop around.
body: Name your capybara, then join the park. Anyone else on the site at the same time shows up as a friend nearby.
If the lobby cannot be reached, the game still works solo.

announcements.title: Name your capybara
announcements.summary: When you press Play, type a name and pick a male or female capybara. Your name floats above you in the park.
body: The village now asks who you are before you walk in. Type a name, choose a male capybara (a bit bigger) or a female capybara (with a flower), then join the park.
Your name sits over your capybara so friends can tell you apart. Clothes and coins still stay in this browser. Pause, then Save code, if you want a copy you can paste back later.

announcements.title: New neighbors in the square
announcements.summary: Juniper the courier and Sable the carpenter are in the village, and the notice board posts a new job each day.
body: Juniper waits by the notice board. Sable hangs around the first plot sign and will ask you to claim land, haul planks, and raise a cottage.
The notice board picks one small job for the day. Finish it, or leave it; a new note is up after midnight in the game clock.

announcements.title: Play in the browser
announcements.summary: The same CappyWorld village from this project runs on the Play page. No install.
body: Open Play, wait for the park to load, then press Play on the game menu. WASD or the arrows walk. Space hops. F flops. E, or the Go button, talks, enters a gate, or picks up clothes.
Press E by the broom to fly. W and S set your speed, A and D turn, Space climbs, and Shift or C comes down. At a station, press E to ride the train.
Clothes and coins stay in this browser. Pause, then Save code, if you want to keep a copy you can paste back later.
